title: E-Ink on Android, and other new things!
summary: A Technology Connections update video in which Alec Watson tests an Onyx Boox Max e-ink Android tablet used as an external display and shares channel news. It describes his experience with large-format e-ink.
why: HN recommends it as a thorough real-world account of using an e-ink tablet as a computer monitor.

quote.text: Technology Connections on youtube tried to use an eink display and thoroughly described his experiences.
